blocks.zh: Section 3B: Leak Test Methods 8.10–8.18 | 洩漏試驗方法 8.10–8.18
blocks.en: Section 3B: Leak Test Methods 8.10–8.18

blocks.zh: Methods Covered in This Section | 本節涵蓋方法
blocks.en: Methods Covered in This Section

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握第 8.10–8.18 節九種洩漏試驗方法的原理、靈敏度與適用性，並能在不同包裝情境中做出正確選擇
blocks.en: Understand the principle, sensitivity and applicability of the nine leak test methods in Sections 8.10–8.18, and be able to select the right method for different packaging situations

blocks.zh: Residual Gas Ionization | 殘留氣體離子化
blocks.en: Residual Gas Ionization

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 殘留氣體離子化 (Residual Gas Ionization)
blocks.en: Principle: Residual Gas Ionization

blocks.zh: 對封裝在真空條件下的容器施加高壓高頻電場。若包裝內有殘餘氣體（代表存在洩漏或真空不足），這些氣體會被電離，附近的導電板即可偵測到電離電流。電流超出允許限值時，該包裝即被拒絕。
blocks.en: A high-voltage, high-frequency electric field is applied to a container sealed under vacuum. If residual gas is present in the package (indicating a leak or insufficient vacuum), the gas is ionized and the resulting ionization current is picked up by a nearby conductive plate. When the current exceeds the allowable limit, the package is rejected.

blocks.zh: 類比：就像螢光燈管在低壓時發光一樣，氣體在高電場下會被激發發光/導電。真空越高（氣體越少），電離越弱；若有洩漏（氣體增加），電離增強。
blocks.en: Analogy: Much like a fluorescent tube glowing at low pressure, gas is excited into glowing/conducting under a high electric field. The higher the vacuum (the less gas), the weaker the ionization; if there is a leak (more gas), the ionization becomes stronger.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 | Key Points
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: 定性方法（Qualitative）：只能判斷通過/拒絕，無法量化洩漏速率
blocks.en: Qualitative method: gives only pass/reject; cannot quantify the leak rate

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Non-destructive）：包裝完好無損，可回收
blocks.en: Non-destructive: the package remains intact and can be returned to the line

blocks.zh: 僅適用於真空密封包裝，不適用正壓包裝
blocks.en: Applies only to vacuum-sealed packages; not suitable for positive-pressure packages

blocks.zh: 測試時間極短（<1秒），適合生產線上的100%在線檢查
blocks.en: Very short test time (<1 second), suitable for 100% in-line inspection on the production line

blocks.zh: 包裝材料本身不能有太高的電離電位（即材料不能太導電）
blocks.en: The package material itself must not have too high an ionization potential (i.e. the material must not be too conductive)

blocks.zh: 時間效應 | Time-Dependent Sensitivity
blocks.en: Time-Dependent Sensitivity

blocks.zh: 靈敏度會隨時間延長而提高：若包裝在密封後存放較久再測，即使只有微小洩漏，積累的氣體也較多，更容易被偵測。這意味著可以在包裝完成後延遲一段時間再測，以提高靈敏度。
blocks.en: Sensitivity increases with time: if a package is stored for a longer period after sealing before testing, even a tiny leak will have allowed more gas to accumulate, making it easier to detect. This means testing can be deferred for a period after packaging to improve sensitivity.

blocks.zh: 實際應用 | Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 常見於凍乾注射劑（lyophilized injectables）的玻璃瓶封裝完整性檢查。凍乾後瓶內為真空，殘留氣體離子化法可快速篩選出真空不足的瓶子。
blocks.en: Commonly used for container closure integrity checks of glass vials containing lyophilized injectables. After freeze-drying the vial is under vacuum, and residual gas ionization can quickly screen out vials with insufficient vacuum.

blocks.zh: Tracer Gas Leak Detection | 示蹤氣體洩漏偵測
blocks.en: Tracer Gas Leak Detection

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 示蹤氣體洩漏偵測 (Tracer Gas Leak Detection)
blocks.en: Principle: Tracer Gas Leak Detection

blocks.zh: 將示蹤氣體（tracer gas）置於密封的一側，另一側用惰性載體氣體沖洗，再用分析儀器偵測載體中是否含有示蹤氣體。示蹤氣體的選擇通常為：
blocks.en: A tracer gas is placed on one side of the seal, the other side is swept with an inert carrier gas, and an analytical instrument checks whether the carrier contains tracer gas. Typical tracer gas choices are:

blocks.zh: 氧氣（O₂）：庫侖計偵測器（coulometric detector）
blocks.en: Oxygen (O₂): coulometric detector

blocks.zh: 二氧化碳（CO₂）/ 水蒸氣：光電感測器
blocks.en: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) / water vapor: photoelectric sensor

blocks.zh: 其他惰性氣體（氦氣 He 等）：質譜儀
blocks.en: Other inert gases (helium, He, etc.): mass spectrometer

blocks.zh: 定量方法（Quantitative）：可測量實際洩漏/滲透速率
blocks.en: Quantitative method: can measure the actual leakage/permeation rate

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Non-destructive）：對包裝無應力
blocks.en: Non-destructive: no stress applied to the package

blocks.zh: 測試時間長（數小時至數天）——不適合高通量 100% 在線檢查
blocks.en: Long test time (hours to days), so not suitable for high-throughput 100% in-line inspection

blocks.zh: 測試夾具（test fixture）的設計是靈敏度的關鍵變數
blocks.en: The design of the test fixture is a key variable for sensitivity

blocks.zh: 適合評估需要特定氣體頭頂空間的包裝（如充 N₂ 的凍乾劑、充 CO₂ 的液體）
blocks.en: Suitable for evaluating packages that require a specific headspace gas (e.g. N₂-filled lyophilized products, CO₂-filled liquids)

blocks.zh: 何時使用示蹤氣體法？ | When to Use?
blocks.en: When to Use?

blocks.zh: 當您需要確認包裝在整個保質期內的氣體屏障性能時，示蹤氣體法最合適。例如：某凍乾注射劑要求氧氣含量 <1%，需驗證包裝在 2 年貨架期內的滲透速率是否符合。
blocks.en: The tracer gas method is best suited when you need to confirm the gas barrier performance of the package over the entire shelf life. For example, if a lyophilized injectable requires an oxygen content of <1%, you need to verify that the permeation rate of the package over a 2-year shelf life is acceptable.

blocks.zh: 與其他方法對比 | vs. Other Methods
blocks.en: vs. Other Methods

blocks.zh: 示蹤氣體法同時測量洩漏（leakage）與滲透（permeation），而壓力衰減法只測洩漏。因此，若要完整評估包裝屏障性能，示蹤氣體法更全面，但耗時更長。
blocks.en: The tracer gas method measures both leakage and permeation, whereas the pressure decay method measures leakage only. For a complete evaluation of package barrier performance, tracer gas is therefore more comprehensive, but it takes longer.

blocks.zh: Ultrasonic Detection of Gas Flow | 超聲波氣流偵測
blocks.en: Ultrasonic Detection of Gas Flow

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 超聲波氣流偵測 (Ultrasonic Detection of Gas Flow)
blocks.en: Principle: Ultrasonic Detection of Gas Flow

blocks.zh: 當加壓包裝有洩漏時，氣體從洩漏處逸出，形成紊流（turbulent flow），產生 20–100 kHz 的超聲波聲能。超聲波感測器偵測此聲能即可判斷是否有洩漏。
blocks.en: When a pressurized package has a leak, gas escaping through the leak site creates turbulent flow, which generates ultrasonic acoustic energy at 20–100 kHz. An ultrasonic sensor detects this acoustic energy to determine whether a leak is present.

blocks.zh: 對於較小洩漏，可在密封處塗抹界面活性劑（surfactant），洩漏氣泡破裂時也會產生超聲波訊號。
blocks.en: For smaller leaks, a surfactant can be applied to the seal area; the bursting of leak bubbles also generates an ultrasonic signal.

blocks.zh: 定性方法（Qualitative）：判斷通過/拒絕
blocks.en: Qualitative method: pass/reject determination

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Non-destructive）
blocks.en: Non-destructive

blocks.zh: 測試幾乎瞬間完成，適合生產線在線檢查
blocks.en: The test is almost instantaneous, suitable for in-line inspection on the production line

blocks.zh: 限制：僅能偵測到能產生紊流的較大洩漏；微小洩漏可能被漏掉
blocks.en: Limitation: it detects only larger leaks that produce turbulent flow; very small leaks may be missed

blocks.zh: 背景噪音是干擾主要來源，需在驗證中評估
blocks.en: Background noise is the main source of interference and must be evaluated during validation

blocks.zh: 需要包裝有足夠的頭頂空間（headspace），或可被擠壓加壓
blocks.en: The package needs sufficient headspace, or must be able to be squeezed to pressurize it
Comparison: 8.12 vs. 8.13 Ultrasonic Methods

blocks.zh: 8.12（氣流偵測）：偵測氣體從洩漏處逸出的聲音，需要有壓差，適合壓力密封包裝。
blocks.en: 8.12 (gas flow detection): detects the sound of gas escaping from the leak site; requires a pressure differential and is suited to pressure-sealed packages.

blocks.zh: 8.13（超聲波成像）：用脈衝超聲波掃描密封界面，偵測密封缺陷的影像，不需要氣體流動，適合評估密封品質。
blocks.en: 8.13 (ultrasonic imaging): scans the seal interface with pulsed ultrasound to image seal defects; no gas flow is needed and it is suited to evaluating seal quality.

blocks.zh: 適用包裝範例 | Applicable Packages
blocks.en: Applicable Packages

blocks.zh: 軟袋（IV bags）、充氣泡殼包裝（blister packs）、含正壓頭空間的安瓿（ampoules under pressure）。不適合依靠曲折路徑密封（tortuous path seal）的容器。
blocks.en: Flexible bags (IV bags), gas-filled blister packs, and ampoules with a positive-pressure headspace. Not suitable for containers that rely on a tortuous path seal.

blocks.zh: Ultrasonic Imaging | 超聲波成像
blocks.en: Ultrasonic Imaging

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 超聲波成像 (Ultrasonic Imaging)
blocks.en: Principle: Ultrasonic Imaging

blocks.zh: 以高頻（數百 MHz）超短脈衝超聲波掃描密封界面。超聲波在材料界面（如密封面與空氣間）發生反射、散射、吸收，反射回波形成影像。缺陷（如分層、污染物、間隙）會顯示出異常的反射特徵。
blocks.en: Very short pulses of high-frequency ultrasound (hundreds of MHz) scan the seal interface. The ultrasound undergoes reflection, scattering and absorption at material interfaces (such as between the seal surface and air), and the reflected echoes form an image. Defects (such as delamination, contaminants and gaps) show abnormal reflection characteristics.

blocks.zh: 可分為兩種模式：
blocks.en: Two modes are available:

blocks.zh: 反射模式（Reflection mode）：分析反射回波影像
blocks.en: Reflection mode: analyzes the image of the reflected echoes

blocks.zh: 透射模式（Transmission mode）：發射器與接收器夾住密封區域，檢測穿透強度
blocks.en: Transmission mode: a transmitter and a receiver sandwich the seal area, and the transmitted intensity is measured

blocks.zh: 定性方法（Qualitative）：影像判讀通過/拒絕
blocks.en: Qualitative method: pass/reject based on image interpretation

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Non-destructive）：無應力施加於包裝
blocks.en: Non-destructive: no stress applied to the package

blocks.zh: 測試時間極短（<1秒），適合生產線
blocks.en: Very short test time (<1 second), suitable for the production line

blocks.zh: 特別適合偵測密封面污染（product-contaminated seals），這是其他方法難以偵測的
blocks.en: Particularly good at detecting product-contaminated seals, which other methods find difficult to detect

blocks.zh: 驗證需涵蓋乾式測試 vs. 水浸測試兩種模式
blocks.en: Validation should cover both the dry test and the water-immersion test modes

blocks.zh: 頻率越高，解析度越好，但穿透深度越淺
blocks.en: The higher the frequency, the better the resolution, but the shallower the penetration depth

blocks.zh: 實務優勢 | Practical Advantage
blocks.en: Practical Advantage

blocks.zh: 超聲波成像是少數能夠可視化密封缺陷位置的方法。不僅能說「有缺陷」，還能精確指出缺陷在密封區域的哪個部位，特別適合密封工藝開發與故障分析（root cause investigation）。
blocks.en: Ultrasonic imaging is one of the few methods that can visualize the location of a seal defect. It can not only say that a defect exists but also pinpoint where in the seal area it lies, which makes it especially useful for sealing process development and root cause investigation.

blocks.zh: 熱封袋（pouches with thermal seals）、黏合密封袋（adhesive bonded seals）。常用於評估熱封工藝參數範圍的驗證（如溫度、壓力、時間的邊界條件測試）。
blocks.en: Pouches with thermal seals and adhesive-bonded seals. Commonly used to validate the range of heat-sealing process parameters (e.g. boundary-condition testing of temperature, pressure and time).

blocks.zh: Vacuum/Pressure Decay (Differential) | 真空/壓力衰減（差壓法）
blocks.en: Vacuum/Pressure Decay (Differential)

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 真空/壓力衰減差壓法
blocks.en: Principle: Vacuum/Pressure Decay (Differential)

blocks.zh: 對包裝施加壓差，測量壓力/真空度隨時間的變化。有兩種測量模式：
blocks.en: A pressure differential is applied to the package, and the change in pressure/vacuum is measured over time. There are two measurement modes:

blocks.zh: 絕對壓力模式（Absolute）：直接測量測試腔的壓力變化
blocks.en: Absolute mode: directly measures the pressure change in the test chamber

blocks.zh: 差壓模式（Differential）：將測試包裝的壓力變化與參考包裝（control）比較，消除環境溫度波動影響
blocks.en: Differential mode: compares the pressure change of the test package with that of a reference (control) package, eliminating the effect of ambient temperature fluctuations

blocks.zh: 有四種測試構型：
blocks.en: There are four test configurations:

blocks.zh: Vacuum rise（真空上升）：外腔抽真空，包裝內部有氣壓；若有洩漏，氣體進入外腔，壓力上升
blocks.en: Vacuum rise: the outer chamber is evacuated while the package interior is at pressure; if there is a leak, gas enters the outer chamber and the pressure rises

blocks.zh: Pressure decay（壓力衰減）：對包裝施加正壓；若有洩漏，壓力下降
blocks.en: Pressure decay: positive pressure is applied to the package; if there is a leak, the pressure falls

blocks.zh: 可為定性或定量（Qualitative or Quantitative），取決於儀器與條件
blocks.en: Can be qualitative or quantitative, depending on the instrument and conditions

blocks.zh: 靈敏度排序：差壓 > 絕對壓力；壓力衰減 > 真空上升
blocks.en: Sensitivity ranking: differential > absolute pressure; pressure decay > vacuum rise

blocks.zh: 真空上升最大壓差限制為 1 atm；壓力衰減可施加更大壓差
blocks.en: The maximum pressure differential for vacuum rise is limited to 1 atm; pressure decay can apply a larger differential

blocks.zh: 液體（或半固體）可能在真空下堵塞洩漏點，造成偽陰性
blocks.en: Liquid (or semi-solid) may plug the leak site under vacuum, causing false negatives

blocks.zh: 包裝的潛變（creep）效應（特別是軟包裝）會干擾壓力讀數
blocks.en: Package creep (especially in flexible packaging) can interfere with the pressure reading

blocks.zh: 8.14 vs. 8.15 區別 | Key Distinction
blocks.en: Key Distinction: 8.14 vs. 8.15

blocks.zh: 8.14（差壓/衰減法）：從外部施加壓差，測量腔室或包裝的壓力/真空變化。較靈敏，適合一般密封完整性檢查。
blocks.en: 8.14 (differential/decay method): applies a pressure differential from the outside and measures the pressure/vacuum change in the chamber or package. More sensitive; suited to general seal integrity checks.

blocks.zh: 8.15（直接量測/保留法）：用穿刺裝置直接進入包裝頭空間，讀取絕對壓力值。適合需維持真空或正壓的包裝（如凍乾劑）。
blocks.en: 8.15 (direct measurement/retention method): uses a piercing device to enter the package headspace directly and read the absolute pressure value. Suited to packages that must maintain a vacuum or positive pressure (e.g. lyophilized products).

blocks.zh: 選擇考量 | Selection Considerations
blocks.en: Selection Considerations

blocks.zh: 含液體的注射劑瓶在真空測試時，液體可能被吸入密封處堵住洩漏，宜改用壓力衰減法。粉末或凍乾劑則兩者均可適用。測試腔容積越小，靈敏度越高。
blocks.en: For liquid-filled injectable vials under vacuum testing, the liquid may be drawn into the seal and block the leak, so the pressure decay method is preferable. For powders or lyophilized products, either method is applicable. The smaller the test chamber volume, the higher the sensitivity.

blocks.zh: Vacuum/Pressure Retention (Absolute) | 真空/壓力保留（絕對量測法）
blocks.en: Vacuum/Pressure Retention (Absolute)

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 真空/壓力保留絕對量測法
blocks.en: Principle: Vacuum/Pressure Retention (Absolute)

blocks.zh: 使用穿刺裝置（piercing device）插入包裝頭空間，連接絕對壓力計直接讀取包裝內部壓力值。若包裝設計為真空密封（如凍乾劑），測得值應接近 0（真空）；若為充氮密封（如正壓包裝），應讀到預定壓力值。
blocks.en: A piercing device is inserted into the package headspace and connected to an absolute pressure gauge to read the internal package pressure directly. If the package is designed to be vacuum-sealed (e.g. lyophilized products), the measured value should be close to 0 (vacuum); if it is nitrogen-filled (e.g. a positive-pressure package), the specified pressure value should be read.

blocks.zh: 比較 8.14 與 8.15 的核心差異：
blocks.en: Core differences between 8.14 and 8.15:

blocks.zh: 8.14：從外部施加壓差，測量腔室變化（不穿刺）
blocks.en: 8.14: applies a pressure differential from the outside and measures the chamber change (no piercing)

blocks.zh: 8.15：穿刺進入包裝頭空間，直接讀絕對壓力
blocks.en: 8.15: pierces into the package headspace and reads the absolute pressure directly

blocks.zh: 由於需要穿刺包裝，通常視為破壞性（Destructive）測試（部分設計可重新密封，但一般屬破壞性）
blocks.en: Because the package must be pierced, this is generally regarded as a destructive test (some designs can be resealed, but in general it is destructive)

blocks.zh: 可為定性或定量（Qualitative or Quantitative）
blocks.en: Can be qualitative or quantitative

blocks.zh: 測試速度快（數秒）
blocks.en: Fast test (a few seconds)

blocks.zh: 關鍵挑戰：穿刺過程不能改變包裝內的壓力——穿刺工具的設計至關重要
blocks.en: Key challenge: the piercing process must not alter the pressure inside the package, so the design of the piercing tool is critical

blocks.zh: 包裝內的水蒸氣壓（water vapor pressure）會影響讀數，需在解讀時校正
blocks.en: The water vapor pressure inside the package affects the reading and must be corrected for when interpreting results

blocks.zh: 典型應用場景 | Typical Application
blocks.en: Typical Application

blocks.zh: 凍乾注射劑（lyophilized injectables）的真空品質確認。例如：凍乾結束後，抽取樣品，以穿刺法確認瓶內真空值是否在規格內（如 <200 mTorr），以此評估凍乾工藝的一致性。
blocks.en: Confirming the vacuum quality of lyophilized injectables. For example, after freeze-drying, samples are taken and pierced to confirm that the vial vacuum is within specification (e.g. <200 mTorr), as a way of evaluating the consistency of the lyophilization process.

blocks.zh: 注意事項 | Caution
blocks.en: Caution

blocks.zh: 此方法因涉及穿刺，不適用於生產線 100% 在線檢查，通常作為抽樣測試（sampling test）或工藝開發中使用。
blocks.en: Because it involves piercing, this method is not suitable for 100% in-line inspection on the production line; it is usually used as a sampling test or during process development.

blocks.zh: Visual Inspection | 目視檢查
blocks.en: Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 目視檢查 (Visual Inspection)
blocks.en: Principle: Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: 最傳統的包裝完整性方法。透過人工目視或電子/機器視覺系統，觀察包裝外部是否有產品滲漏的跡象（如液體痕跡、顏色變化、包裝變形等）。
blocks.en: The most traditional package integrity method. Through human visual inspection or an electronic/machine vision system, the outside of the package is examined for signs of product leakage (such as liquid traces, color change or package deformation).

blocks.zh: 可搭配溫度或壓力應力（stress test），迫使潛在洩漏點顯現，提高靈敏度。
blocks.en: It can be combined with temperature or pressure stress to force potential leak sites to show themselves, increasing sensitivity.

blocks.zh: 定性方法（Qualitative）、非破壞性（Non-destructive）
blocks.en: Qualitative method, non-destructive

blocks.zh: 唯一適用於所有包裝類型的方法（無限制）
blocks.en: The only method applicable to all package types (no restrictions)

blocks.zh: 靈敏度低：僅能偵測到已發生可見產品外滲的較大洩漏
blocks.en: Low sensitivity: detects only larger leaks where visible product leakage has already occurred

blocks.zh: 人工目視受操作員訓練、燈光、角度等主觀因素影響，可重複性低
blocks.en: Manual visual inspection is affected by subjective factors such as operator training, lighting and viewing angle, so repeatability is low

blocks.zh: 電子視覺系統（AVI）速度快但仍依賴影像對比，對微小洩漏不靈敏
blocks.en: Automated visual inspection (AVI) systems are fast but still rely on image contrast and are not sensitive to very small leaks

blocks.zh: 是法規（FDA、EMA）要求的最低基線方法，幾乎所有產品都需進行
blocks.en: It is the minimum baseline method required by regulators (FDA, EMA) and is needed for almost all products

blocks.zh: 目視檢查的局限性 | Limitations
blocks.en: Limitations

blocks.zh: 目視檢查只能看到「已發生的洩漏痕跡」，無法預測或偵測尚未顯現的微小洩漏。就像汽車的機油警告燈——它告訴你機油已經不夠了，而不是告訴你某個密封件有微小裂縫即將失效。
blocks.en: Visual inspection can only see "traces of a leak that has already occurred"; it cannot predict or detect small leaks that have not yet become visible. It is like the oil warning light in a car: it tells you the oil is already low, not that a seal has a tiny crack and is about to fail.

blocks.zh: 法規要求 | Regulatory Context
blocks.en: Regulatory Context

blocks.zh: FDA 無菌工藝指南（2004）要求所有注射劑進行 100% 目視檢查（21 CFR 211.167）。但同時也建議補充更靈敏的確定性方法（deterministic methods），如壓力衰減法，以確保微小洩漏也能被偵測。
blocks.en: The FDA aseptic processing guidance (2004) requires 100% visual inspection of all injectable products (21 CFR 211.167). It also recommends supplementing this with more sensitive deterministic methods, such as pressure decay, to ensure that small leaks are detected as well.

blocks.zh: Volumetric Gas Flow | 體積氣流法
blocks.en: Volumetric Gas Flow

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 體積氣流法 (Volumetric Gas Flow)
blocks.en: Principle: Volumetric Gas Flow

blocks.zh: 對包裝施加正壓，用流量計（flow meter）測量從包裝洩漏逸出的氣體流量（單位：mL/min 或 sccm）。流量越大，代表洩漏越嚴重。
blocks.en: Positive pressure is applied to the package, and a flow meter measures the flow of gas escaping from the package leak (units: mL/min or sccm). The larger the flow, the more severe the leak.

blocks.zh: 與壓力衰減法的差異：
blocks.en: Difference from the pressure decay method:

blocks.zh: 體積氣流法：直接測量流量（流速）
blocks.en: Volumetric gas flow: measures flow (flow rate) directly

blocks.zh: 壓力衰減法（8.14）：測量壓力下降速率（間接計算流量）
blocks.en: Pressure decay (8.14): measures the rate of pressure drop (flow is calculated indirectly)

blocks.zh: 定量方法（Quantitative）：可測量實際氣體流量
blocks.en: Quantitative method: can measure the actual gas flow

blocks.zh: 靈敏度低於壓力衰減法（flow meter 精度限制）
blocks.en: Sensitivity is lower than the pressure decay method (limited by flow meter accuracy)

blocks.zh: 測試時間短（數秒）
blocks.en: Short test time (a few seconds)

blocks.zh: 特別適合易在壓力下變形（deform）的包裝——變形包裝用壓力衰減法會因包裝膨脹/收縮造成偽陽性，而流量法不受此影響
blocks.en: Particularly suitable for packages that deform easily under pressure: with a deformable package, pressure decay can give false positives because the package expands/contracts, whereas the flow method is not affected

blocks.zh: 適合測試特定孔徑（critical orifice）規格，如吸入器（inhaler）的噴嘴
blocks.en: Suitable for testing a specified orifice size (critical orifice), such as the nozzle of an inhaler

blocks.zh: 何時選擇體積法 vs. 壓力衰減法？
blocks.en: When to Choose Volumetric vs. Pressure Decay?

blocks.zh: 如果包裝是軟袋（如輸液袋）或其他在加壓時容易形變的容器，壓力衰減法讀數會受形變影響而失真。此時選擇體積氣流法更可靠，因為它直接測量逸出氣體量，不受容器形變影響。
blocks.en: If the package is a flexible bag (such as an infusion bag) or another container that deforms readily when pressurized, pressure decay readings will be distorted by the deformation. In that case the volumetric gas flow method is more reliable, because it measures the amount of escaping gas directly and is not affected by container deformation.

blocks.zh: Weight Loss / Gain | 重量損失/增加法
blocks.en: Weight Loss / Gain

blocks.zh: 原理說明 — 重量損失/增加法 (Weight Loss/Gain)
blocks.en: Principle: Weight Loss/Gain

blocks.zh: 利用天平稱重監測包裝在特定儲存條件下的重量變化：
blocks.en: An analytical balance is used to monitor the change in package weight under defined storage conditions:

blocks.zh: 重量損失（Weight Loss）：包裝內含揮發性物質（如有機溶劑、乾冰），在壓力/溫度條件下，物質蒸發逸出，重量降低
blocks.en: Weight loss: the package contains a volatile substance (such as an organic solvent or dry ice) that evaporates and escapes under pressure/temperature conditions, so the weight decreases

blocks.zh: 重量增加（Weight Gain）：包裝內含乾燥劑等吸濕性物質，在高濕環境下，水蒸氣滲入，重量升高
blocks.en: Weight gain: the package contains a hygroscopic substance such as a desiccant, and under high humidity water vapor enters, so the weight increases

blocks.zh: 使用對照包裝（control packages，填充惰性材料）同步測試，以扣除環境因素影響。
blocks.en: Control packages (filled with an inert material) are tested in parallel to subtract the effect of environmental factors.

blocks.zh: 定量方法（Quantitative）：可測量洩漏 + 滲透的總量
blocks.en: Quantitative method: can measure the total of leakage + permeation

blocks.zh: 非破壞性（Non-destructive）：稱重後包裝可繼續使用/觀察
blocks.en: Non-destructive: after weighing, the package can continue to be used/observed

blocks.zh: 適用範圍廣：適合所有包裝類型與密封型式
blocks.en: Broad applicability: suitable for all package types and seal designs

blocks.zh: 測試時間很長（數天至數週）——不適合在線檢查
blocks.en: The test time is very long (days to weeks), so it is not suitable for in-line inspection

blocks.zh: 靈敏度取決於天平精度與重量變化量
blocks.en: Sensitivity depends on balance accuracy and the amount of weight change

blocks.zh: 是 USP <661> 和 <671> 的參考方法，法規認可度高
blocks.en: It is a reference method in USP <661> and <671> and is widely accepted by regulators

blocks.zh: 同時測量洩漏與滲透（leakage + permeation），無法區分兩者貢獻
blocks.en: It measures leakage and permeation together, and the contribution of each cannot be distinguished

blocks.zh: 最適應用 | Best Use Case
blocks.en: Best Use Case

blocks.zh: 包裝保質期驗證與貨架壽命研究（shelf-life study）中，用於確認包裝在整個保質期內的阻隔性能是否符合規格。例如：確認含乾燥劑的膠囊瓶在 25°C/60%RH 條件下，2 年內水分增重不超過限值。
blocks.en: In package shelf-life validation and shelf-life studies, to confirm that the barrier performance of the package meets specification throughout the shelf life. For example, confirming that a capsule bottle containing a desiccant gains no more than the limit of moisture over 2 years at 25°C/60%RH.

blocks.zh: USP 關聯 | USP Reference
blocks.en: USP Reference

blocks.zh: USP <671>（容器滲透性）規定了水蒸氣滲透的測試方法，重量法是其核心方法之一。USP <661>（注射用容器）也引用重量法作為容器密封性的評估工具。
blocks.en: USP <671> (Containers - Permeation) specifies test methods for water vapor permeation, and the gravimetric method is one of its core methods. USP <661> (Containers for injections) also cites the gravimetric method as a tool for evaluating container closure tightness.

blocks.zh: Master Comparison Table: All 18 Methods | 全部 18 種方法總比較表
blocks.en: Master Comparison Table: All 18 Methods

blocks.zh: 使用說明 | How to Use This Table
blocks.en: How to Use This Table

blocks.zh: 本表涵蓋 TR27 第 8.1–8.18 節所有 18 種洩漏試驗方法的關鍵特性比較，供方法選擇與驗證計畫制定時參考。靈敏度排序為相對比較，實際數值取決於儀器、測試條件與包裝系統。
blocks.en: This table compares the key characteristics of all 18 leak test methods in TR27 Sections 8.1–8.18, as a reference for method selection and validation planning. The sensitivity ranking is a relative comparison; actual values depend on the instrument, test conditions and packaging system.

blocks.zh: Vacuum/Pressure Decay Types Explained | 真空/壓力衰減類型詳解
blocks.en: Vacuum/Pressure Decay Types Explained

blocks.zh: 四種構型中文解析 | Four Configurations Explained
blocks.en: Four Configurations Explained

blocks.zh: 記憶口訣：壓差 > 絕對；衰減 > 上升
blocks.en: Memory aid: differential > absolute; decay > rise

blocks.zh: 靈敏度排序（由高至低）：
blocks.en: Sensitivity ranking (high to low):

blocks.zh: 壓力衰減 + 差壓感測（Pressure Decay Differential）—— 最高
blocks.en: Pressure decay + differential sensing (Pressure Decay Differential): highest

blocks.zh: 壓力衰減 + 絕對感測（Pressure Decay Absolute）
blocks.en: Pressure decay + absolute sensing (Pressure Decay Absolute)

blocks.zh: 真空上升 + 差壓感測（Vacuum Rise Differential）
blocks.en: Vacuum rise + differential sensing (Vacuum Rise Differential)

blocks.zh: 真空上升 + 絕對感測（Vacuum Rise Absolute）—— 最低
blocks.en: Vacuum rise + absolute sensing (Vacuum Rise Absolute): lowest

blocks.zh: 為何差壓更靈敏？
blocks.en: Why Is Differential More Sensitive?

blocks.zh: 差壓模式中，測試包裝與參考包裝（無洩漏）同時加壓/抽真空。環境溫度波動對兩個腔室的影響幾乎相同，因此在差壓讀數中被抵消。這大幅減少了溫度漂移造成的假訊號，讓儀器可以偵測更微小的真實壓力變化。
blocks.en: In differential mode, the test package and a reference package (with no leak) are pressurized/evacuated at the same time. Ambient temperature fluctuations affect the two chambers almost equally, so they cancel out in the differential reading. This greatly reduces false signals from temperature drift and lets the instrument detect smaller real pressure changes.

blocks.zh: 液體包裝的特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for Liquid Packages

blocks.zh: 含液體的包裝（如注射液）在真空上升測試中，液體可能被吸入密封點，暫時封堵洩漏路徑，導致偽陰性（false negative）。此情況宜改用壓力衰減法，從包裝內部向外加壓，液體不會被吸向密封處。
blocks.en: In a vacuum rise test, liquid in a liquid-filled package (such as an injectable) may be drawn into the seal point and temporarily block the leak path, causing a false negative. In this case the pressure decay method is preferable, as it pressurizes from inside the package outward and the liquid is not drawn toward the seal.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions | 練習思考題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Reinforce understanding of TR27 Section 8.10–8.18 | 強化對 8.10–8.18 方法的理解
blocks.en: Reinforce understanding of TR27 Section 8.10–8.18

blocks.zh: Question 1 | 題目一
blocks.en: Question 1

blocks.zh: 一種凍乾注射劑在玻璃瓶中真空密封。您需要在生產線上對每個瓶子進行 100% 在線容器密封完整性測試（CCIT），每瓶測試時間不超過一秒。哪種方法最合適？請說明理由。
blocks.en: A lyophilized injectable is vacuum-sealed in a glass vial. You need to perform 100% in-line container closure integrity testing (CCIT) on every vial on the production line, with no more than one second of test time per vial. Which method is most suitable? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: Show Answer | 顯示答案
blocks.en: Show Answer

blocks.zh: Best answer: 8.10 Residual Gas Ionization (殘留氣體離子化)
blocks.en: Best answer: 8.10 Residual Gas Ionization

blocks.zh: 理由：殘留氣體離子化法（8.10）：速度極快（<1秒）、非破壞性、專為真空密封設計，完全符合在線 100% 檢查的要求。另需補充 8.16 目視檢查（法規要求）。雷射頭空間分析（8.5）若有條件也可考慮，靈敏度更高。
blocks.en: Rationale: Residual gas ionization (8.10) is extremely fast (<1 second), non-destructive and designed for vacuum-sealed packages, so it fully meets the requirements for 100% in-line inspection. It should be supplemented by 8.16 visual inspection (a regulatory requirement). Laser headspace analysis (8.5), if available, could also be considered and has higher sensitivity.

blocks.zh: Question 2 | 題目二
blocks.en: Question 2

blocks.zh: 您正在驗證軟性塑膠袋裝藥品的容器密封完整性測試。在方法開發中發現，施加差壓時袋子明顯形變，導致壓力衰減測試結果不穩定。您會建議哪種替代方法？關鍵驗證參數有哪些？
blocks.en: You are validating a container closure integrity test for a drug product in flexible plastic bags. During method development you find that the bag deforms visibly when a pressure differential is applied, making pressure decay results unstable. Which alternative method would you recommend? What are the key validation parameters?

blocks.zh: Recommended: 8.17 Volumetric Gas Flow (體積氣流法)
blocks.en: Recommended: 8.17 Volumetric Gas Flow

blocks.zh: 答案：推薦 8.17 體積氣流法。TR27 明確指出此法「常用於替代易形變包裝的壓力衰減法」。因為流量計直接測量逸出氣體量，不受容器形變影響。關鍵驗證參數：流量計精度、測試時間、施加壓差。輔助方案：8.13 超聲波成像，可評估熱封品質。
blocks.en: Answer: 8.17 Volumetric Gas Flow is recommended. TR27 states explicitly that this method is "often used as an alternative to pressure decay for packages that deform". Because the flow meter measures the amount of escaping gas directly, it is not affected by container deformation. Key validation parameters: flow meter accuracy, test time and applied pressure differential. Supporting option: 8.13 ultrasonic imaging, which can evaluate heat seal quality.

blocks.zh: Question 3 | 題目三
blocks.en: Question 3

blocks.zh: 一個產品團隊正在開發裝有乾燥劑的高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）瓶裝口服固體製劑，需要建立水分滲入的保質期規格。哪種 TR27 方法最適合評估 24 個月保質期的防潮性能？此方法的關鍵限制是什麼？
blocks.en: A product team is developing an oral solid dosage form in a high-density polyethylene (HDPE) bottle containing a desiccant, and needs to establish a shelf-life specification for moisture ingress. Which TR27 method is most suitable for evaluating moisture barrier performance over a 24-month shelf life? What is the key limitation of this method?

blocks.zh: Best answer: 8.18 Weight Gain (重量增加法)
blocks.en: Best answer: 8.18 Weight Gain

blocks.zh: 答案：8.18 重量增加法最合適。理由：(1) 直接測量水分滲入量（重量增加），最符合保質期評估需求。(2) 瓶中乾燥劑本身即為吸濕材料，無需另行填充。(3) 定量，可獲得 mg/day 滲透速率。(4) USP <671> 引用此法。限制：測試時間長（數週至數月）；同時測量洩漏與滲透，無法區分；需同步測試對照包裝。
blocks.en: Answer: 8.18 Weight Gain is the most suitable. Reasons: (1) it directly measures moisture ingress (weight gain), which best fits shelf-life evaluation needs; (2) the desiccant in the bottle is itself the hygroscopic material, so nothing extra needs to be filled; (3) it is quantitative and yields a permeation rate in mg/day; (4) USP <671> cites this method. Limitations: long test time (weeks to months); it measures leakage and permeation together and cannot distinguish them; control packages must be tested in parallel.

blocks.zh: Question 4 — Comparison | 題目四 — 方法比較
blocks.en: Question 4: Comparison

blocks.zh: 比較 8.14 與 8.15。一位 QA 工程師說「這兩個都是真空/壓力測試，可以互換使用。」您是否同意？請說明關鍵差異，並舉出一個只有其中一種適用的情境。
blocks.en: Compare 8.14 and 8.15. A QA engineer says, "These are both vacuum/pressure tests and can be used interchangeably." Do you agree? Explain the key differences and give one scenario where only one of them is applicable.

blocks.zh: 不同意，兩者本質不同：8.14 在包裝外部施加壓差，偵測腔室壓力變化，非破壞性，適合在線 100% 測試。8.15 需要穿刺進入頭空間直接讀絕對壓力值，通常為破壞性，僅用於抽樣。情境：凍乾劑頭空間真空確認（需知道實際真空值 mTorr），只有 8.15 能提供此資訊。
blocks.en: Disagree; the two are fundamentally different: 8.14 applies a pressure differential outside the package and detects the pressure change in the chamber; it is non-destructive and suitable for 100% in-line testing. 8.15 requires piercing into the headspace to read the absolute pressure value directly; it is usually destructive and used only for sampling. Scenario: confirming the headspace vacuum of a lyophilized product (where the actual vacuum value in mTorr must be known), for which only 8.15 can provide the information.
